payload.reason: The evidence indicates that several tasks were evaluated in previous work, specifically focusing on syntactic phenomena and language models.

claims.text: Previous work evaluated the ability of LSTMs to learn subject-verb agreement patterns in English using naturally occurring sentences.
BIBREF2 evaluated subject-verb agreement in a controlled setting using nonce sentences to focus on syntax rather than selectional preferences.
BIBREF3 considered a wider range of syntactic phenomena using manually constructed stimuli, allowing for greater control.
